# CHE-32 task T002: one uv workspace for the three Python packages

**Target**: `packages/backfire`, `packages/doc-regions`, `packages/wiki-consistency` and a new root uv workspace; the selected Python sites in selected-sites.md; the selected line of `plugins/work/skills/wiki-consistency/SKILL.md`.

**Change**:

1. New root `pyproject.toml`: a non-package root (`[tool.uv] package = false`, `required-version = ">=0.11.32"`) with `[tool.uv.workspace] members = ["packages/*"]`, `[tool.turbo] name = "verbose-broccoli-python"`, `requires-python = ">=3.14"`, and root `constraint-dependencies` that keep today's versions: `typesafe-sdk==0.7.1` (backfire's own `constraint-dependencies` line stays: its row is `review`), `starlette<=0.52.1`, `openai<=3.19.2`, `pyjwt<=2.15.0`, `sse-starlette<=3.4.11`, `magika<=0.6.3` (an exact `magika==0.6.3` fails: today's lock keeps 0.6.2 on Windows). New root `.python-version` (3.14.4) and root `uv.lock` from `uv lock`. Acceptance: the root lock's package versions equal the union of today's three per-package locks (write a short comparison in your report; a probe on 2026-09-29 found zero differences over 79 packages).
2. Build backend (D6): switch all three packages from setuptools to `uv_build` (pin a version range that uv 0.11.32 provides), with module settings that keep today's modules and package data: backfire has three top-level modules under `src` (`backfire`, `backfire_tools`, `backfire_education`) and data files `config.toml`, `UPSTREAM.md` and `backfire_education/config.toml`; wiki-consistency ships `search.mjs`; doc-regions has `doc_regions`. Remove `egg_base` and the setuptools-only tables. In `packages/wiki-consistency/pyproject.toml`, `doc-regions` becomes `{ workspace = true }` (uv refuses a path source to a workspace member). Only the pyproject sites the classification selects may change; if a needed pyproject change is not selected, ask.
3. Delete the three per-package `uv.lock` files (rows `W:packages/*/uv.lock`, SELECT delete). The per-package `.python-version` files stay (their rows are `review`).
4. `packages/backfire/src/backfire/ready.py`: readiness accepts the environment of the uv project that contains it (D6): the root `.venv` for the repository package, the copy's own `.venv` in a built plugin; its `uv sync ... --check` checks must pass against a root `.venv` synced with `--all-packages` (an exact per-member check reports packages to uninstall). The requirement stays: in a built plugin, readiness proves the server runs from that copy's own `.venv`. Change only the selected lines (S177 line 77, S189 line 275 and any batch-2 rows).
5. `packages/backfire/src/backfire_tools/build.py` (D7, D10): the built copy keeps its own `uv.lock`: export backfire's pins from the root lock (`uv export --package backfire --frozen --no-hashes --no-emit-workspace ...`, with `--extra education` for the work build) and run `uv lock --offline` in the copy with those pins as constraints; for the work build, give the copied `doc-regions` and `wiki-consistency` their own locks the same way, and in the copied `wiki-consistency/pyproject.toml` only, replace `doc-regions = { workspace = true }` with the path source `../doc-regions` (editable as today). The documented install and start commands (docs/backfire.md lines 31 and 41, plugins/*/mcp.json, plugins/work/skills/wiki-consistency/SKILL.md) must keep working unchanged. The usage message at line 145 names `npm run backfire:build -- <plugin> <output>` (T001 keeps the task names).
6. Messages and tests that name `deno task <name>` (S110 to S114, S123) now name `npm run <name>`; the selected test sites (test_load, test_ready, test_build, test_education_e2e, test_regions and any batch-2 rows such as test_entry) follow the new layout.
7. Sync and test: `uv sync --locked --all-packages` at the root (plus `--extra education` so backfire's education extra is installed), then run each package's tests from the root with `uv run --frozen --offline --no-sync --package <name> pytest ...`, and the backfire slow tests too if they ran before. If the old per-package `.venv` directories are in the way, you may delete `packages/*/.venv` (they are ignored, rebuildable environments).

**Constraints**: Only the files in Ownership. Built plugins must still install offline, stay self-contained and write nothing outside their own `.venv` (`test_load.py`). Do not touch `tools/spec-kit` or `tools/shellcheck`. Do not edit `turbo.json`, `package.json`, `scripts/*`, `orca.yaml`, docs or CI (T001 and T003 own them); if you need a Turborepo or doctor change, write the exact change in your report. CHE-29 (another branch) changes Python lint settings; do not add Ruff or lint configuration.

**Ownership**: `pyproject.toml`, `.python-version`, `uv.lock` (root, new); `packages/backfire/**`, `packages/doc-regions/**`, `packages/wiki-consistency/**` (Python files, pyproject, locks, .python-version; not `package.json` or `package-lock.json` unless selected); `plugins/work/skills/wiki-consistency/SKILL.md` (selected lines only); your report `specs/019-turborepo/evidence/worker-T002.md`.

**Observable acceptance**:
- `uv lock --check` passes at the root; the version comparison with the three old locks shows no difference, or names each one.
- `uv sync --locked --all-packages --extra education` succeeds; `uv run --frozen --offline --no-sync --package backfire pytest packages/backfire/tests -m 'not slow'` passes (report counts; the base commit had 1,351 passed, 3 deselected), as do the doc-regions tests with `scripts/doc_sources_test.py` (base: 107) and the wiki-consistency tests (base: 118).
- `test_load.py`, `test_ready.py`, `test_entry.py` and `test_build.py` pass; a code and a work plugin built into a temporary directory outside the repository install with the documented commands offline and pass `backfire ready`'s offline preflight part (the provider call needs credit and network; report what ran).
- `git diff --stat` shows only owned files.


Later additions approved by the coordinator after backfire_classify: test_build.py:107-118 (built-tree comparison), ready.py:90-101 (sync check), build.py:103-110 (copied pyproject names only the modules it contains). A follow-up (T002b) removes the root pyproject's [project] table; the root pyproject below is before that follow-up.
